title: Trivial + ≥1 MIL baseline with model cards (honest reporting)
context: The benchmark needs honest baselines to anchor comparisons: a trivial/majority baseline (the sanity floor, proving reported gains are non-trivial) and at least one multiple-instance learning (MIL) baseline (e.g. ABMIL or CLAM-style tile-aggregation). Every reported number must carry its full provenance (split ID, seed(s), across-seed variance, preprocessing hash, compute provenance) — no single-seed headline claims. Each baseline must ship a model card: intended use = research benchmarking only, not clinical; training data + license; metrics with variance; known limitations including site effects. Heavy GPU training runs become funded tasks; the donated-lane deliverable is the code plus a CPU-feasible/trivial baseline. Domain-reviewer sign-off required. See PLAN.md (Baselines + model cards).
objective: Implement and report: (1) a trivial/majority-class baseline (runs on CPU, reports primary metric); (2) at least one MIL baseline (e.g. ABMIL or CLAM-style tile encoder + aggregator). Report every result with split ID, seed(s), across-seed variance, preprocessing hash, and compute provenance. Write a model card for each baseline: intended use (research benchmarking only, not clinical), training data + license, reported metrics with variance, known limitations including site/scanner bias. The donated-lane code must be structured so a heavy GPU run can be done as a separate funded task.
acceptanceCriteria: A trivial/majority-class baseline is implemented, runs on CPU, and reports the primary benchmark metric.
At least 1 MIL baseline is implemented (e.g. ABMIL or CLAM-style tile encoder + aggregator).
Every reported result carries: split ID, seed(s), across-seed variance (multiple seeds reported), preprocessing hash, and compute provenance. No single-seed headline numbers.

Each baseline ships a model card stating: intended use = research benchmarking only (not clinical or diagnostic), training data and license, metrics with variance, known limitations (including site/scanner effects).
Model cards carry the 'not for clinical or diagnostic use; research only' notice; CI not-for-clinical-use linter passes.
Domain-reviewer sign-off on baseline results is recorded in the governance log.
The code is structured so that a heavy GPU training run can be isolated into a separate funded task with a fundedBudgetUsd cap.
output: A PR containing the trivial and MIL baseline code (Python adapter), result records with full honest provenance (split/seeds/variance/preprocessing-hash/compute), and model cards for each baseline.
